ModMetaData.name: RimPunk CE
ModMetaData.author: Henry Frodsham
ModMetaData.description:
Cyberware, cyberpsychosis and adrenaline for Combat Extended. Operating systems (sandevistan, berserk, cyberdecks, chrome compressor), arm cyberware, prefrontal cortex implants and more, all tiered from T1 to Iconic.
Requires Royalty, Harmony, Combat Extended. Multiplayer compatible. Works with Interaction Bubbles (barks and comms chatter show as speech bubbles, comms ones in blue; without it barks show as floating text) and Quality Bionics Remastered: cyberware gets quality, which scales its effects.
Icons by Lorc, Delapouite, Andy Meneely and Sbed from game-icons.net, CC BY 3.0, recoloured.
